routes.description_en: Daemon-owned Provider proxy for the Pi agent path (`agent://personal/pi`). When a control-plane binding exists, the request model must match that binding and there is no fallback. Unbound agents still use `provider.json` / `selected-model.json`. Secrets resolve server-side only. Unary `stream:false` success responses carry `X-CognitiveOS-Provider-Network-Nanos`. Public `stream:true` is forwarded as SSE (`text/event-stream`) and flushes upstream bytes without waiting for a unary JSON body; streaming success omits the network-nanos header because it is unknown when headers flush. Pi conversations and private-candidate remain unary. When `COGNITIVEOS_PI_ROUTE_OBSERVATION=enabled` and the request carries one well-formed opaque `campaign-<32 lowercase hex>` correlation id, the daemon also echoes that id and reports `X-CognitiveOS-Daemon-Preflight-Nanos` (config/selected-model/SecretStore work, disjoint from the network exchange). Malformed or duplicate correlation headers are ignored; the product body is unchanged and nothing is persisted.
routes.description_zh: daemon 持有的 Pi 路径 Provider 代理（`agent://personal/pi`）。存在控制面 binding 时，请求 model 必须匹配该 binding，且无回退。未绑定 agent 仍使用 `provider.json` / `selected-model.json`。secret 仅在服务端解析。一元 `stream:false` 成功响应携带 `X-CognitiveOS-Provider-Network-Nanos`。公开 `stream:true` 按 SSE（`text/event-stream`）转发，并在不等待一元 JSON body 的情况下刷新上游字节；流式成功省略 network-nanos 头，因为刷新响应头时总时长未知。Pi 对话与 private-candidate 保持一元。当 `COGNITIVEOS_PI_ROUTE_OBSERVATION=enabled` 且请求携带一条形态正确的不透明 `campaign-<32 位小写 hex>` correlation id 时，daemon 还会回显该 id 并报告 `X-CognitiveOS-Daemon-Preflight-Nanos`（配置/selected-model/SecretStore，与网络交换互不重叠）。畸形或重复的 correlation 头被忽略；产品 body 不变，且绝不持久化。

routes.description_zh: 读取 task/campaign 范围的钉住 HTTPS origin 白名单。缺失记录表示生产 HttpFetchReadOnly 白名单保持为空（失败闭合）。普通 task 调用方被拒绝。

routes.description_en: Pin exact HTTPS origins (host or host:port) for one task_ref under an authorized campaign. GET/HEAD only; no credentials, redirects, inherited proxy, or request body. Unauthorized campaigns and task-channel callers fail closed.
routes.description_zh: 在授权 campaign 下为一个 task_ref 钉住精确 HTTPS origin（host 或 host:port）。仅 GET/HEAD；无凭据、不跟随重定向、不继承代理、无请求体。未授权 campaign 与 task 通道调用方失败闭合。

routes.description_en: Project registered native Tools with overlay lifecycle, execution_readiness, and whether each is currently Agent-exposed. Overlay state never enters the immutable descriptor digest.
routes.description_zh: 投影已登记原生 Tool 的 overlay lifecycle、execution_readiness，以及当前是否对 Agent 暴露。overlay 状态永不进入不可变 descriptor digest。

routes.description_en: Alias of the registered Tool lifecycle projection; stops the previous generic-authority fall-through on tool/discover.
routes.description_zh: 已登记 Tool lifecycle 投影的别名；阻止先前 tool/discover 落入通用 authority 处理器。

routes.description_en: Enable one registered operation_id. Quarantined and revoked Tools fail closed. Task-channel callers are denied.
routes.description_zh: 启用一个已登记 operation_id。被隔离或撤销的 Tool 失败闭合。task 通道调用方被拒绝。

routes.description_en: Disable one registered operation_id. Agent exposure updates atomically with the overlay.
routes.description_zh: 禁用一个已登记 operation_id。Agent 暴露随 overlay 原子更新。

routes.description_en: Quarantine one registered operation_id. Enable remains blocked until a later non-quarantine overlay is out of scope for this surface.
routes.description_zh: 隔离一个已登记 operation_id。在本表面内 enable 保持阻断。

routes.description_en: Revoke one registered operation_id. Revocation is terminal for this overlay.
routes.description_zh: 撤销一个已登记 operation_id。对本 overlay 而言撤销是终态。

routes.description_en: Read the current least Agent exposure set and digest for one task_ref.
routes.description_zh: 读取一个 task_ref 当前最窄 Agent 暴露集合及其 digest。

routes.description_en: Task-channel read of the same registered Tool lifecycle projection.
routes.description_zh: task 通道读取同一份已登记 Tool lifecycle 投影。

routes.description_en: Return the least Agent-exposed Tool set and exposure_digest for one task_ref. Extra prompt/body/receipt query keys fail closed.
routes.description_zh: 返回一个 task_ref 的最窄 Agent 暴露集合与 exposure_digest。额外的 prompt/body/receipt 查询键失败闭合。

routes.description_en: Record a bounded Tool selection receipt: candidate_set_digest must equal the current exposure digest, the selected operation_id must be exposed, and prompt/body/receipt restatement is refused.
routes.description_zh: 记录有界 Tool 选择收据：candidate_set_digest 必须等于当前暴露 digest，所选 operation_id 必须已被暴露，且拒绝 prompt/body/receipt 重述。

routes.description_en: Snapshot-first bounded Task watch with optional resume_from.
routes.description_zh: 快照优先的有界 Task watch，支持可选 resume_from。

routes.description_en: Task-bound Memory/Skill resource projection (requires task_ref); served through the `/task/resource/` prefix rewrite onto the shared resource handler.
routes.description_zh: Task 绑定的 Memory/Skill 资源投影（需要 task_ref）；经 `/task/resource/` 前缀重写复用共享 resource 处理器。

routes.description_en: Task-bound resource watch, served through the same prefix rewrite.
routes.description_zh: Task 绑定的资源 watch，经同一前缀重写提供。

routes.description_en: Return the latest daemon-authored redacted Memory/Skill consumption pins for one task_ref; query_text and skill_binding_id are rejected as restatement; forgotten, revoked, or digest-drifted records fail closed without pins.
routes.description_zh: 返回一个 task_ref 上最新的 daemon 写入脱敏 Memory/Skill 消费钉；query_text 与 skill_binding_id 视为重述并拒绝；遗忘、撤销或 digest 漂移的记录在返回钉之前失败闭合。

routes.description_en: Record a Task-trace Memory/Skill consumption bound to current authority facts.
routes.description_zh: 记录绑定当前权威事实的 Task trace Memory/Skill 消费。

routes.description_en: Write a secret-excluding Personal backup archive. Never copies authority SQLite, bootstrap secrets, bearer material, or provider-config.
routes.description_zh: 写入排除 secret 的 Personal 备份归档。永不复制 authority SQLite、bootstrap secret、bearer 或 provider-config。

routes.description_en: Verify one archive_id (schema, part digests, completeness, secret/SQLite exclusion) without mutating live layout.
routes.description_zh: 校验一个 archive_id（schema、分片 digest、完整性、secret/SQLite 排除）且不改写 live layout。

routes.description_en: Preflight then transactionally restore one archive_id. Failure rolls live trees back; secrets and SQLite stay uncopied.
routes.description_zh: 预检后事务恢复一个 archive_id。失败则回滚 live 树；secret 与 SQLite 仍不被复制。

routes.description_en: Forbidden: backup/restore are management-channel only.
routes.description_zh: 禁止：backup/restore 仅限 management 通道。

routes.description_en: Forbidden: backup/restore are management-channel only.
routes.description_zh: 禁止：backup/restore 仅限 management 通道。

routes.description_en: Forbidden alias of the management backup writer.
routes.description_zh: 禁止：management 备份写入器的 task 别名。

routes.description_en: Forbidden alias of the management restore writer.
routes.description_zh: 禁止：management 恢复写入器的 task 别名。

routes.description_en: Personal-private Project list from v26 `p11_project` rows. Empty list has no fake buttons. Cost is `unknown` and is never serialized as 0. Not Task-row impersonation and not P7-T05 inventory.
routes.description_zh: 从 v26 `p11_project` 行投影的 Personal-private Project 列表。空列表无假按钮。费用为 `unknown`，序列化里不出现 0。不是 Task 行冒充，也不动 P7-T05 inventory。

routes.description_en: Personal-private Project detail. A Task ref is not a Project id (404). Unconfirmed drafts have no Project row.
routes.description_zh: Personal-private Project 详情。Task ref 不是 Project id（404）。未确认草稿没有 Project 行。

routes.description_en: Current PlanRevision axis (stages, gap flags, confirm_status). Missing plan is empty/unavailable, not a fake wizard.
routes.description_zh: 当前 PlanRevision 流程轴（环、gap 标记、confirm_status）。无计划时为空/unavailable，不是假向导。

routes.description_en: Employee roster. Empty projection uses `authority_note: empty-roster`. Seated members list `employee_id`, state, responsible stages, model_bound, and current-manager flag. Not a third identity besides Employee.
routes.description_zh: 员工花名册。空投影使用 `authority_note: empty-roster`。已就位成员列出 `employee_id`、state、负责环、model_bound 与 current-manager 标记。不是 Employee 之外的第三套身份。

routes.description_en: Grant catalog for one Employee in one Project. Recipe mention is not a grant.
routes.description_zh: 一个 Project 内一名 Employee 的 Grant 目录。配方提及不是授权。

routes.description_en: Pending ApprovalPreview announcement list. Omits `preview_digest` (conversation/canvas announcement seam).
routes.description_zh: 待批 ApprovalPreview 宣布列表。省略 `preview_digest`（对话/画布宣布接缝）。

routes.description_en: Canvas preview-detail: includes `preview_digest`, `receipt_ref`, and `superseded_by` for management confirm/reject/narrow. Not a chat Approve control.
routes.description_zh: 画布 preview-detail：含供 management 确认/拒绝/改窄的 `preview_digest`、`receipt_ref`、`superseded_by`。不是聊天 Approve 控件。

routes.description_en: Apply a candidate onto an open draft at exact `base_seq`. Wrong seq is conflict (N13).
routes.description_zh: 按精确 `base_seq` 把候选应用到未关闭草稿。错误 seq 为冲突（N13）。

routes.description_en: Open a Project-create draft and put its charter. Does not mint a Project. Activation still requires preview.request then confirm.
routes.description_zh: 打开 Project-create 草稿并写入 charter。不铸造 Project。激活仍须 preview.request 再 confirm。

routes.description_en: Mint a digest-bound ApprovalPreview (activation / plan-change / acceptance / grant-expansion). Response includes `preview_digest` for canvas confirm. Secret-shaped bytes are rejected at registration.
routes.description_zh: 签发 digest 绑定的 ApprovalPreview（activation / plan-change / acceptance / grant-expansion）。响应含供画布确认的 `preview_digest`。secret 形态字节在登记时拒绝。

routes.description_en: Owner-management reject of a pending ApprovalPreview. Leaves a receipt. The rejected digest is never confirmable. Not a chat Approve control.
routes.description_zh: Owner management 拒绝待批 ApprovalPreview。留下 receipt。被拒 digest 永不可确认。不是聊天 Approve 控件。

routes.description_en: Owner-management narrow: mint a new pending preview and freeze the old row as superseded (`superseded_by`). Old digest is never confirmable. Stale is mechanical `base_state_digest` mismatch only.
routes.description_zh: Owner management 改窄：签发新的 pending preview，旧行 `superseded`（`superseded_by`）。旧 digest 永不可确认。stale 只按机械 `base_state_digest` 不等判定。

routes.description_en: Owner-management confirm of `{preview_id, preview_digest}`. G1 mints Project in `creating`; G2 writes AcceptanceFact then `active`; grant-expansion inserts a Grant. Stale digest is rejected.
routes.description_zh: Owner management 确认 `{preview_id, preview_digest}`。G1 铸造 `creating` 的 Project；G2 写入 AcceptanceFact 后进入 `active`；grant-expansion 写入 Grant。过期 digest 拒绝。

routes.description_en: Settings list of non-revoked StandingApprovalPolicy rows (time-box ≤7d). Chat cannot mint. Not Inbox L1.
routes.description_zh: Settings 列出未撤销的 StandingApprovalPolicy（时间盒 ≤7 天）。聊天不能签发。不是 Inbox 一级。

routes.description_en: Mint a time-boxed StandingApprovalPolicy. `expires_at` is required and must be ≤7 days from now. Missing or over-long expiry fails closed.
routes.description_zh: 签发有时限的 StandingApprovalPolicy。`expires_at` 必填且距现在 ≤7 天。缺省或超长失败闭合。

routes.description_en: Settings revoke of one StandingApprovalPolicy. Chat/task aliases are 403.
routes.description_zh: Settings 撤销一条 StandingApprovalPolicy。聊天/task 别名为 403。

routes.description_en: Register one Employee per PlanRevision responsible_slot. Missing or extra slots are rejected. Not a Role=Agent merge.
routes.description_zh: 按 PlanRevision 每个 responsible_slot 登记一名 Employee。缺槽或多成员拒绝。不是 Role=Agent 合并。

routes.description_en: Begin sequential seating for one Employee. A second seating while another is seating is conflict.
routes.description_zh: 开始一名 Employee 的顺序就位。另一名仍在 seating 时冲突。

routes.description_en: Owner-management seating confirm. Missing model → pending; reject → refused; project-manager seating requires the unique current-manager slot.
routes.description_zh: Owner management 就位确认。无模型 → pending；拒绝 → refused；project-manager 就位占用唯一 current-manager 槽。

routes.description_en: Replace `runtime_binding_ref` without changing `employee_id`. Process death does not delete the Employee.
routes.description_zh: 替换 `runtime_binding_ref` 且不改 `employee_id`。进程退出不删除 Employee。

routes.description_en: Speech router plus T05 archive landing: whitelist-filtered delivered kinds persist under `cognitiveos.personal.conversation-archive/0.1`. Chatter stays audit-only. Legacy `conversation-projection/0.1` / `v01` is not coerced.
routes.description_zh: 发言路由加 T05 档案落地：白名单投递 kind 写入 `cognitiveos.personal.conversation-archive/0.1`。chatter 仅审计。旧 `conversation-projection/0.1` / `v01` 不被 coerce。

routes.description_en: Owner-management append of one archive record (`note`/`deliverable`/`handoff`/`blocked`/`decision-request`). Chatter and oversize bodies fail closed. Observation-only; not Task/Project completion. Legacy `conversation-projection/0.1` is not coerced.
routes.description_zh: Owner management 追加一条档案行（`note`/`deliverable`/`handoff`/`blocked`/`decision-request`）。chatter 与超长正文失败闭合。仅观察，不是 Task/Project 完成。旧 `conversation-projection/0.1` 不被 coerce。

routes.description_en: Bounded scoped index of Personal-private conversation archive refs. Requires `limit` 1..=32; omitted/oversize limit is unbounded resume. `include_bodies` is refused. Returns record_id/digest only. Does not reinterpret ADR-0058 `conversation-projection/0.1`.
routes.description_zh: 有界按 Project 索引 Personal-private 对话档案引用。必须带 `limit` 1..=32；缺省或超限视为无界 resume。`include_bodies` 拒绝。只返回 record_id/digest。不重解释 ADR-0058 `conversation-projection/0.1`。

routes.description_en: Single-record body fetch inside one Project. Not a bulk dump. Cross-scope record ids fail closed.
routes.description_zh: 在同一 Project 内读取单条档案正文。不是整库倾倒。跨范围 record_id 失败闭合。

routes.description_en: Record a handoff row with `authority_stays=1`. Chat cannot transfer authority.
routes.description_zh: 记录 `authority_stays=1` 的 handoff 行。聊天不能转移权威。

routes.description_en: Hidden Pi Personal Assistant real inference (P13-T03; exact Pi 0.81.1, frame `cognitiveos.personal.assistant-inference/0.1`): explain/navigate/research/propose assemble a bounded Context in T10 inject order, invoke exact Pi once through `pi-agent-adapter assistant-turn` with the Provider reached only via the daemon's one-shot private completion socket (`agent://personal/pi` binding), parse Pi's final text into a closed candidate object chain (business-brief → research-run → charter/axis/roster/recipe) whose every field carries typed provenance (`sources` | `owner-stated` | `assistant-assumption`), and register it as a digest-bound draft candidate (research/propose also announce a daemon preview). Response carries `reply`, `chain`, `model_id`, `provider_round_trips`, bounded `context` layers and `research.fetched/refused`. No Provider bound → HTTP 409 `ASSISTANT_PROVIDER_UNBOUND` with a Settings pointer and nothing registered. Echo (zero Provider round trips), prose, fabricated `sources[]`, unprovenanced fields, ambient tools (403 before Pi spawns), and out-of-schema chains are refused (422) with nothing registered. Research fetch: `research_targets[]` (≤4) only through the `HttpFetchReadOnly` pre-validator against pinned origins for `task://personal/assistant-research`; refused targets are reported, never fetched. Candidate-only: no Approve, no archive/SecretStore/Memory/authority write. Pi is not an Installed Agent. Windows Pi route is `not-run` until P13-T13.
routes.description_zh: 隐藏 Pi Personal Assistant 真实推理（P13-T03；exact Pi 0.81.1，帧 `cognitiveos.personal.assistant-inference/0.1`）：explain/navigate/research/propose 按 T10 注入顺序组装有界 Context，经 `pi-agent-adapter assistant-turn` 真实调用 exact Pi 一次，Provider 只经 daemon 一次性私有 completion socket（`agent://personal/pi` 绑定）到达；把 Pi 最终文本解析为封闭候选对象链（business-brief → research-run → charter/axis/roster/recipe），每个字段带 typed 出处（`sources` | `owner-stated` | `assistant-assumption`），再登记为带 digest 的草稿候选（research/propose 另发 daemon preview 宣布）。响应含 `reply`、`chain`、`model_id`、`provider_round_trips`、有界 `context` 层与 `research.fetched/refused`。Provider 未绑 → HTTP 409 `ASSISTANT_PROVIDER_UNBOUND` 并指路 Settings，不登记任何东西。回显（零 Provider 往返）、纯文本、伪造 `sources[]`、无出处字段、ambient tool（Pi 启动前 403）、越出 schema 的链一律 422 拒绝且不登记。research fetch：`research_targets[]`（≤4）只经 `HttpFetchReadOnly` 预校验器对 `task://personal/assistant-research` 的 pinned origins；被拒目标只报告、绝不抓取。只产 candidate：无 Approve、无 archive/SecretStore/Memory/权威写。Pi 不是 Installed Agent。Windows Pi 路由在 P13-T13 前为 `not-run`。

routes.description_en: What the create-page assistant chat may render (P13-T03): `ready` (Provider bound to `agent://personal/pi` and exact Pi configured; `chat_input: true`), `provider_unbound` (Settings pointer, `chat_input: false`, no silent bind, no key prompt), or `pi_unavailable` (bound but the exact Pi runtime is not configured on this daemon). Derived from daemon facts only; never from the client. Carries engine / pin / protocol identifiers, `model_id` when bound, and the pinned research origin count.
routes.description_zh: 创建页助手聊天可渲染的状态（P13-T03）：`ready`（`agent://personal/pi` 已绑 Provider 且 exact Pi 已配置；`chat_input: true`）、`provider_unbound`（指路 Settings，`chat_input: false`，不静默绑模型、不索要 key）或 `pi_unavailable`（已绑但本 daemon 未配置 exact Pi 运行时）。只由 daemon 事实推导，绝不来自客户端。携带 engine / pin / protocol 标识、已绑时的 `model_id` 以及 pinned research origin 数量。

routes.description_en: Hidden hosted DSH Attempt-runner start: persist a managed child identity (artifact digest / protocol / optional observed pid) onto Employee `runtime_binding_ref`. Reuses Path B `POST /provider/v1/dsh/chat/completions` as the only secret-bearing path. Isolated spawn fail-closes on Windows GNU. Not Installed Agent chrome. Windows OPC E2E is `not-run`.
routes.description_zh: 隐藏托管 DSH Attempt-runner start：把托管子进程身份（artifact digest / protocol / 可选观测 pid）持久绑定到 Employee `runtime_binding_ref`。复用 Path B `POST /provider/v1/dsh/chat/completions` 作为唯一持 secret 路径。Windows GNU 上 isolated spawn 失败闭合。不是 Installed Agent chrome。Windows OPC E2E 为 `not-run`。

routes.description_en: Observe hosted DSH child exit. Clears pid observation. Does not delete Employee, conversation archive, or Memory.
routes.description_zh: 观察托管 DSH 子进程退出。清除 pid 观测。不删除 Employee、对话档案或 Memory。

routes.description_en: Hidden hosted DSH real Attempt loop (P13-T02): records an artifact health fact (unpinned → 422, no spawn), persists the Attempt Intent, binds the v31 child identity, then the daemon broker spawns the exact-artifact child with the bounded Context (≤64 KiB, secret-shape refused) on stdin and brokers `observation` / `candidate` / `heartbeat` / `response` frames back as observations. The daemon writes the terminal observation (`exited` / `signaled` / `timed-out` / `spawn-failed`; never `success`); `completion_claimed` is always `false` and verification stays `not-run`. Direct Provider frames are refused and recorded; Path A / API-key / native MCP flags never spawn. `wait` (default true) blocks up to `timeout_ms` (≤30 min). Windows sandbox / ACL / supply-chain E2E is `not-run` until P13-T13.
routes.description_zh: 隐藏托管 DSH 真实 Attempt 循环（P13-T02）：先记 artifact 健康事实（未钉住 → 422，不 spawn），再持久化 Attempt Intent 并绑定 v31 子进程身份，然后 daemon broker 以 stdin 递交有界 Context（≤64 KiB，secret-shape 被拒）真实 spawn exact-artifact 子进程，并把 `observation` / `candidate` / `heartbeat` / `response` 帧作为观察回收。终态观察由 daemon 写入（`exited` / `signaled` / `timed-out` / `spawn-failed`；永无 `success`）；`completion_claimed` 恒为 `false`，verification 保持 `not-run`。直连 Provider 帧被拒并记录；Path A / API key / native MCP 标志不会 spawn。`wait`（默认 true）最多阻塞 `timeout_ms`（≤30 分钟）。Windows sandbox / ACL / supply-chain E2E 在 P13-T13 前为 `not-run`。

routes.description_en: Newest-first hosted Attempt history for one `project_id` (the `runs` data source, P13-T05 renders it). Every row carries `completion_claimed=false`, `verification_status=not-run`, and a terminal kind that is never `success`. `limit` 1..=64.
routes.description_zh: 一个 `project_id` 的托管 Attempt 历史（最新在前；`runs` 数据源，P13-T05 渲染）。每行 `completion_claimed=false`、`verification_status=not-run`，终态类别永无 `success`。`limit` 1..=64。

routes.description_en: One hosted Attempt plus its redacted frame ledger (`observation` / `candidate` / `heartbeat` / `response` / `rejected`, each `authority_written=false`). Secret shapes are redacted before persistence; a surviving shape fails the response closed.
routes.description_zh: 一个托管 Attempt 及其脱敏帧台账（`observation` / `candidate` / `heartbeat` / `response` / `rejected`，每条 `authority_written=false`）。secret 形状在持久化前脱敏；残留形状使响应失败闭合。

routes.description_en: Observe the configured hosted DSH artifact (`dsh.json` revision, `.cognitiveos-dsh-revision` pin file, hosted child script digest) and append a durable fact. Kind is derived: `health-check`, `update` (configured revision changed), or `rollback` (returned to the previous revision). Health `pinned` | `absent` | `corrupt` | `mismatch` | `script-missing`; only `pinned` admits a spawn. Never spawns.
routes.description_zh: 观察已配置的托管 DSH artifact（`dsh.json` revision、`.cognitiveos-dsh-revision` 钉住文件、托管子脚本 digest）并追加一条 durable 事实。kind 由 daemon 推导：`health-check`、`update`（配置 revision 变化）或 `rollback`（回到上一个 revision）。health 为 `pinned` | `absent` | `corrupt` | `mismatch` | `script-missing`；只有 `pinned` 允许 spawn。绝不 spawn。

routes.description_en: Latest hosted DSH artifact fact plus newest-first history (`limit` 1..=64) and `admits_spawn`. Facts are append-only.
routes.description_zh: 最新托管 DSH artifact 事实与最新在前的历史（`limit` 1..=64）及 `admits_spawn`。事实仅追加。

routes.description_en: Newest-first Attempt artifacts of one `project_id` (P13-T04; the `outputs` select-then-view source). Each row is a CAS reference (`sha256:` digest, byte length, `text/markdown`), its source candidate frame, `freshness` (`current` | `superseded`), `verification_status` (`not-run` | latest independent-verifier disposition), the stage whose current StageTestPassed points at it, and `accepted_at`. Also lists run acceptances. Files are never authority; `host_file_open_e2e` is `not-run`.
routes.description_zh: 一个 `project_id` 的 Attempt 产物（最新在前；P13-T04，`outputs` 先选后看的数据源）。每行是 CAS 引用（`sha256:` digest、字节长度、`text/markdown`）、来源候选帧、`freshness`（`current` | `superseded`）、`verification_status`（`not-run` | 最新独立 verifier 结论）、当前 StageTestPassed 指向它的环节，以及 `accepted_at`。同时列出 run 验收事实。文件永远不是权威；`host_file_open_e2e` 为 `not-run`。

routes.description_en: One artifact plus its newest-first evidence history (verifier `verifier://personal/attempt-artifact`, principal `principal://personal/independent-verifier`, per-criterion results, report CAS ref), its run acceptance if any, the `outputs.open` route, and whether a Personal Home `data/` export copy exists (`is_authority: false`).
routes.description_zh: 一个产物及其 evidence 历史（最新在前；verifier `verifier://personal/attempt-artifact`、principal `principal://personal/independent-verifier`、逐条 criteria 结果、报告 CAS 引用）、若有的 run 验收、`outputs.open` 路由，以及 Personal Home `data/` 导出副本是否存在（`is_authority: false`）。

routes.description_en: Serve the deliverable bytes of one `artifact_id` straight from the daemon CAS (`text/markdown; charset=utf-8`). Bytes are re-hashed on read: a tampered CAS file is 409 `ATTEMPT_ARTIFACT_DIGEST_MISMATCH`, never a download. Only `sha256:` CAS refs are openable; paths and `file://` are refused.
routes.description_zh: 直接从 daemon CAS 提供一个 `artifact_id` 的交付物字节（`text/markdown; charset=utf-8`）。读取时重新计算 digest：被篡改的 CAS 文件返回 409 `ATTEMPT_ARTIFACT_DIGEST_MISMATCH`，绝不下载。只有 `sha256:` CAS 引用可打开；路径与 `file://` 被拒。

routes.description_en: Write a copy of one artifact's CAS bytes into Personal Home `data/projects/<project_id>/outputs/` (staging file + rename) so a host application can open it. The copy is `is_authority: false` and is never read back; host file-open E2E stays `not-run` until P13-T13.
routes.description_zh: 把一个产物的 CAS 字节复制到 Personal Home `data/projects/<project_id>/outputs/`（暂存文件 + rename），供宿主应用打开。副本 `is_authority: false`、永不回读；宿主打开文件 E2E 在 P13-T13 前保持 `not-run`。

routes.description_en: Run the independent verifier `verifier://personal/attempt-artifact` (deterministic: CAS re-read digest, source-frame binding, terminal Attempt, format parse, non-empty, no secret shape; the child's `response`/exit are recorded `not-used`) and append one evidence row whose report bytes live in the same CAS. Evidence is append-only and is not acceptance. The daemon already runs this once at ingest.
routes.description_zh: 运行独立 verifier `verifier://personal/attempt-artifact`（确定性：CAS 重读 digest、来源帧绑定、Attempt 终态、格式解析、非空、无 secret 形状；child 的 `response`/exit 记为 `not-used`）并追加一条 evidence，其报告字节放在同一 CAS。evidence 仅追加且不是验收。daemon 在入库时已自动运行一次。

routes.description_en: Derive StageTestPassed (P11-T03 `p11_stage_test_fact`) for `artifact_id` on `stage_id` from durable facts only: real seating, the Attempt's Member holding the stage slot, `current` freshness, passed evidence whose checked digest equals the artifact digest, a CAS re-read, and a terminal Attempt. No caller boolean. A stage test is not acceptance.
routes.description_zh: 只从 durable 事实推导 `artifact_id` 在 `stage_id` 上的 StageTestPassed（P11-T03 `p11_stage_test_fact`）：真实就位、Attempt 成员持有该环节 slot、`current` 新鲜度、checked digest 等于产物 digest 的 passed evidence、CAS 重读、Attempt 终态。没有调用方布尔值。stage test 不是验收。

routes.description_en: Mint a `run-acceptance` ApprovalPreview (P11-T09 shape) for `project_id` / `stage_id`. Refused off the last ring of the current plan, without a current StageTestPassed backed by passed evidence, or once that fact was accepted. Confirm goes through `POST /management/project/v1/confirm` with the preview-detail digest; chat cannot confirm.
routes.description_zh: 为 `project_id` / `stage_id` 铸造 `run-acceptance` ApprovalPreview（P11-T09 形状）。不在当前计划末环、末环无 passed evidence 支撑的当前 StageTestPassed、或该事实已验收时拒绝。确认走 `POST /management/project/v1/confirm` 并带 preview-detail digest；聊天不能确认。

routes.description_en: Append-only run acceptance facts of one `project_id` (last ring pinned by CHECK; each bound to one StageTestPassed fact, artifact and evidence; `acceptance_decision_ref`).
routes.description_zh: 一个 `project_id` 的 run 验收事实（仅追加；末环由 CHECK 钉住；每条绑定一个 StageTestPassed 事实、产物与 evidence；`acceptance_decision_ref`）。

routes.description_en: Read-only AUTONOMY publication packet for one verified artifact (`preview` / `override` / `tiered_authority` / `observable` / `outcome_verify` / `memory_of_actions` / `yield`). Always `planned: true`, `published: false`, `chat_can_confirm: false`, `connector: none-qualified`.
routes.description_zh: 一个已验证产物的只读 AUTONOMY 发布包（`preview` / `override` / `tiered_authority` / `observable` / `outcome_verify` / `memory_of_actions` / `yield`）。永远 `planned: true`、`published: false`、`chat_can_confirm: false`、`connector: none-qualified`。

routes.description_en: Mint an `external-send` ApprovalPreview for one verified artifact and record the send Intent as `previewed` (recipients hashed, never stored). Confirm via `POST /management/project/v1/confirm` moves it to `planned` — persist-before-dispatch with no qualified connector, so `published` is `false` by schema CHECK. Planned ≠ published.
routes.description_zh: 为一个已验证产物铸造 `external-send` ApprovalPreview，并把发送 Intent 记为 `previewed`（收件人只存 digest）。经 `POST /management/project/v1/confirm` 确认后变为 `planned`——persist-before-dispatch 且无合格连接器，`published` 由 schema CHECK 钉为 `false`。planned ≠ published。

routes.description_en: External-send Intent ledger of one `project_id` (`previewed` | `planned` | `superseded`; `published` always false; `published_any: false`).
routes.description_zh: 一个 `project_id` 的 external-send Intent 台账（`previewed` | `planned` | `superseded`；`published` 永远 false；`published_any: false`）。

routes.description_en: Import one Markdown Vault file with rights and provenance. Secret-shape, path traversal, conversation-archive-as-Vault, CAS-only blobs, and last-write-wins without a conflict record fail closed. Files are not Project authority. Host filesystem E2E is `not-run`.
routes.description_zh: 导入一份带 rights/provenance 的 Markdown Vault 文件。secret-shape、路径遍历、把对话档案当 Vault、仅 CAS blob、以及无冲突记录的 last-write-wins 失败闭合。文件不是 Project 权威。宿主文件系统 E2E 为 `not-run`。

routes.description_en: Rebuild the derived Vault index from stored documents. Does not write Memory FTS. Index is not Project authority.
routes.description_zh: 从已存文档重建派生 Vault 索引。不写入 Memory FTS。索引不是 Project 权威。

routes.description_en: Query the rebuildable Vault index for one Project. Cross-project `caller_project_id` is retrieval overreach. Returns documented Context inject order (task contract → fixed decisions → sourced excerpts → summaries → older narrative).
routes.description_zh: 查询一个 Project 的可重建 Vault 索引。跨项目 `caller_project_id` 视为检索越权。返回已文档化的 Context 注入顺序（当前 Task 合同 → 已固定决定 → 带出处摘录 → 摘要 → 旧叙述）。

routes.description_en: List open Vault conflicts for one Project. Silent last-write-wins is not a resolver.
routes.description_zh: 列出一个 Project 的 Vault 冲突。静默 last-write-wins 不是解决器。

routes.description_en: Always rejected: a Vault file cannot confirm or apply Project authority. Research notes and decisions stay on draft/authority SQLite.
routes.description_zh: 一律拒绝：Vault 文件不能确认或应用 Project 权威。调研笔记与决定留在草稿/权威 SQLite。

routes.description_en: Daemon-authored Routine revision (P11-T08). Overlap policy is no-overlap-queue-latest. Reuses `scheduler_entries`; not a second Temporal scheduler. Clock/sleep/restart E2E is `not-run`.
routes.description_zh: Daemon 撰写 Routine revision（P11-T08）。重叠策略为 no-overlap-queue-latest。复用 `scheduler_entries`，不是第二套 Temporal 调度器。clock/sleep/restart E2E 为 `not-run`。

routes.description_en: Admit a manual / schedule / qualified-event Trigger. Overlap is rejected or queued as latest; host-unavailable records a visible missed row. Stale revision fail-closes. Silent drop is forbidden.
routes.description_zh: 受理 manual / schedule / qualified-event Trigger。重叠被拒绝或按 queue-latest 排队；host-unavailable 记入可见 missed。过期 revision 失败闭合。禁止静默丢 occurrence。

routes.description_en: List active / queued / missed / coalesced occurrences for one Routine. Not Inbox L1. Requires project_id and routine_id.
routes.description_zh: 列出一条 Routine 的 active / queued / missed / coalesced occurrence。不是 Inbox 一级。需要 project_id 与 routine_id。

routes.description_en: Persist recovery checkpoint bytes. Completing from a checkpoint is rejected (`checkpoint is not completion`).
routes.description_zh: 持久化恢复 checkpoint。用 checkpoint 当完成一律拒绝（`checkpoint is not completion`）。

routes.description_en: Resume a missed internal occurrence onto the daemon scheduler. Consequential auto-resume fail-closes.
routes.description_zh: 把 missed 的 internal occurrence 恢复到 daemon scheduler。consequential 自动恢复失败闭合。

routes.description_en: Admit Personal Home `app/`+`data/` (P11-T02). Install root must end with `Personal Home`; GNU/WSL/Linux roots, ACL escape, and secret env/argv fail closed. Upgrade replaces app and preserves data. Native ACL E2E is `not-run`.
routes.description_zh: 受理 Personal Home `app/`+`data/`（P11-T02）。安装根必须以 `Personal Home` 结尾；GNU/WSL/Linux 根、ACL 逃逸、secret env/argv 失败闭合。升级替换 app、保留 data。原生 ACL E2E 为 `not-run`。

routes.description_en: Bind the single daemon to one admitted Home. Duplicate bind while bound/recovering/resumed fails closed. Tray role is observe-and-request only.
routes.description_zh: 把唯一 daemon 绑到已受理的 Home。已 bound/recovering/resumed 时重复绑定失败闭合。托盘角色仅 observe-and-request。

routes.description_en: Typed close: background-or-pause is honored only when the daemon can honor background; otherwise the request is rejected (fake background forbidden).
routes.description_zh: 类型化关闭：仅当 daemon 能兑现 background 时才接受 background-or-pause；否则拒绝（禁止假 background）。

routes.description_en: Record an explicit offline/missed segment (sleep/shutdown/daemon-stop/network-loss/locked SecretStore/Provider outage). Silent drop is forbidden.
routes.description_zh: 记录显式 offline/missed 时段（sleep/shutdown/daemon-stop/network-loss/锁定 SecretStore/Provider 中断）。禁止静默丢弃。

routes.description_en: Bind a hosted DSH child to the admitted Home. Orphan DSH (no matching daemon bind) fails closed.
routes.description_zh: 把托管 DSH 子进程绑到已受理 Home。无匹配 daemon bind 的孤儿 DSH 失败闭合。

routes.description_en: Start ordered seven-step wake/restart recovery. Skipping a step is rejected. Resume is only eligible work. No execution while the host is off.
routes.description_zh: 启动七步有序 wake/restart 恢复。跳步被拒绝。只恢复合格工作。宿主关闭期间不执行。

routes.description_en: Advance the current recovery by one ordered step. Out-of-order advance fails closed.
routes.description_zh: 按序推进当前恢复一步。乱序推进失败闭合。

routes.description_en: Record a same-disk local restore point. Claiming it as a disaster backup fails closed.
routes.description_zh: 记录同盘本地 restore point。把它声明为灾难备份失败闭合。

routes.description_en: Observe Home/daemon/offline/recovery status. Secrets are omitted. Tray icon is not proof of work.
routes.description_zh: 观察 Home/daemon/offline/recovery 状态。不返回 secret。托盘图标不是工作证明。

routes.description_en: Bind one owner-consented X/Twitter account per Project (P11-T14). SecretStore `secret_ref` only. Hero/default-demo/P0-success-path, evasion, platform-qualified claims, and raw secret env/argv fail closed. Live X API is `not-run`.
routes.description_zh: 每个 Project 绑定一个 owner-consented X/Twitter 账户（P11-T14）。仅 SecretStore `secret_ref`。hero/default-demo/P0-success-path、evasion、platform-qualified 声称与 raw secret env/argv 失败闭合。live X API 为 `not-run`。

routes.description_en: Mint a digest-bound preview of original rights-safe content. Scraped/stolen content, chat Approve, evasion, and secret-shaped bodies fail closed.
routes.description_zh: 签发原创、权利安全内容的 digest 绑定 preview。抓取/盗用内容、聊天 Approve、evasion 与 secret-shape 正文失败闭合。

routes.description_en: Owner-management HITL confirm of one preview digest. Chat Approve is forbidden. Digest mismatch is stale.
routes.description_zh: Owner management HITL 确认一条 preview digest。禁止聊天 Approve。digest 不匹配视为 stale。

routes.description_en: Persist-before-dispatch publish ledger. Unconfirmed preview, receipt-as-completion, and unknown metrics as `0` fail closed. Readback stays `unknown` until a qualified live observation exists.
routes.description_zh: persist-before-dispatch 发布台账。未确认 preview、把 receipt 当完成、unknown 指标写成 `0` 失败闭合。在合格 live observation 之前 readback 保持 `unknown`。

routes.description_en: Redacted connector status. `secret_ref` is omitted. `is_p0_hero` and `platform_qualified` are false. Impressions stay `unknown`.
routes.description_zh: 脱敏 connector 状态。不返回 `secret_ref`。`is_p0_hero` 与 `platform_qualified` 为 false。impressions 保持 `unknown`。
